why: Bare down lists seats for honesty. resolveControlTarget preflight deletes an unreachable broker's registry entry.
A failed dependent (unsignalable manager, live broker pid) must keep that record, or later clean can proceed under a live process.

MUTATION 2 drops the restore. The preserve-registry cell goes red only if listing actually connected and pruned.
